definitions.gloss: draining excess oil from fried foods
definitions.explanation: the process of removing excess oil from deep-fried or pan-fried foods
a rack, paper, or other tool used to drain oil from fried foods

notes:
USAGE:
Fried food is set on a wire rack, on oil-absorbing paper, or stood on end so the oil drips off; this keeps it crisp rather than greasy. Sense 2 appears in {油切|あぶらき}り⟦バット→バット：11590_batto⟧ (draining tray with rack) and {油切|あぶらき}りペーパー (oil-absorbing paper).
